posts.title: Taking Stock of the Current LLM Hype Cycle
posts.description: We’re now several years into the LLM hype cycle and the volume at this point is so noisy and disjointed that it feels muted, like having water in my ears. As an act of survival I have complied with what is expected of me: paying my bills is a far more important act than sticking to my principles. posts.title: Sync Firmware Zoo: A Desktop App for my Synthesizer Psychosis
posts.description: In my enthusiasm for the FM-1 , I have written a pretty big Omnibus desktop app to do stuff with it: Run up to 4 virtual FM-1s in emulation Rewire MIDI inputs/outputs all over the system Catalog, download, and flash firmwares to local devices It supports the M-VAVE FM-1 as well as the SMK-37. You can get it on Github Releases now.

posts.title: Oh, Goddammit: I'm Back on C++ in 2026
posts.description: The title for my autobiography would probably be I Thought I Was a Child Prodigy But I Am Actually a Late Bloomer . Going from being the youngest guy in the room to the oldest guy in the room happens suddenly, surprisingly, and permanently.
